entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.80+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Travel map: the location pictures and name plates are smaller, so more of the map shows by @phckd
- Travel map: the place you are at is now marked in warm gold instead of bright green by @phckd
- Travel map: after choosing 'Classic menu', a clear 'Back to travel map' button sits just above the menu (it was a small button in the corner of the window) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.79+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Travel map: Cairns is now parted from the red Murray country by a channel of open water, and keeps its sandy beach all the way round by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.78+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- New: Travel map. The Locations menu (/tt) now opens as a detailed world map with every location on it: hover for the server's own tooltip, left-click to teleport, right-click to view species. 'Classic menu' on the map switches back to the plain menu, and it can be turned off in the settings (Travel map) by @phckd
- The 'KENAI MINI EVENT » There is no event running right now.' line no longer shows in chat when it comes from FOE+'s own quiet check (mini events only run on weekends) by @phckd
- Gigantic catch message: it can now be copied and shared in chat as plain text (the badge copies as GIGANTIC and the fish picture copies as nothing), and the fish picture sits one space after the badge by @phckd
- Luck & Scale now refreshes right after you put on or take off armor by @phckd
- Leftover 'FoER' text is now FOE+ everywhere (chat prefix, loading text, menu button, key bind) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.77+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fixed the Lightning in a Bottle dry streak not counting during a thunderstorm at night: with the moon up the boss bar shows two icons (moon and ⚡) and FOE+ only kept the first. Every weather icon is now kept, which also fixes Blooming Oasis and Gold Rush being missed at night by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.76+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Community goal: when the goal is hit and the community total starts again, your contribution counter on the top bar starts again from 0 too (then FOE+ checks /communityevent a few seconds later for the exact number) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.75+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Update notice: FOE+ checks its GitHub releases and, only when there's a newer version for your Minecraft version, says so once in chat a few seconds after you join, with a link to download it. Nothing is said when you're up to date (Main Configuration > Tell me about FOE+ updates) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.74+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fixed the Mini Event panel disappearing: any chat line mentioning the mini event (a broadcast, someone's message) right after FOE+'s quiet /minievent check was taken as 'no event on' and cleared it. Now only the server's own 'no mini event' reply does by @phckd
- The Mini Event panel stays up until the event's end time, then FOE+ checks /minievent again for the next one; with every mission done it shows 'All missions done' instead of vanishing by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.73+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Max-roll rod parts (and rods with two different max stats) now get a small purple dot in the top-right corner instead of the purple border by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.72+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fixed the thin purple border on max-roll rod parts coming out uneven or missing a side at some GUI scales: it's now drawn in whole screen pixels by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.71+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- The purple border round max-roll rod parts is now half as thick by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.70+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Rod parts show a small icon in the bottom-left for what they're calibrated for: XP, money, luck, scale, prospect, albino, melanistic, trophy or bite/reel speed (Renderer Configuration > Item Marker > Show rod part calibration icon) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.69+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Luck & Scale now update a few seconds after you equip or unequip a pet, instead of waiting for the next routine /menu check by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.68+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fabled events caught while you were offline now clear from the Events panel: when FOE+'s quiet /events check (or one you type) lists no Fabled event, it's over by @phckd
- FOE+'s first quiet /events check after joining now runs about 12 seconds in, instead of 25 by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.67+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Luck & Scale update within seconds when a Luck or Scale booster starts or ends, even while you keep fishing (the re-read used to wait until you stopped casting) by @phckd
- The first quiet /active check runs about 5 seconds after you join (was 30) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.66+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Booster timers stay exact: /active is also checked quietly 5 seconds after any booster's chat line and as soon as a booster timer runs out (in case another is queued), and every line of its answer is read and hidden by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.65+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Events panel: global Money and XP boosters show with their multiplier and time left, counting down live (Luck and Scale boosters stay next to their numbers on the Luck & Scale panel) by @phckd
- FOE+ checks /active quietly after you join and every 15 minutes (its answer hidden), so every booster timer is exact, including boosters popped before you logged in; ones that have ended are cleared by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.64+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Luck & Scale: the booster timer works with the real chat line ('has activated a Global Scale Booster » 2x for 60m!'); Luck & Scale also re-read themselves from /menu a few seconds after a booster is popped and when it runs out by @phckd
- A friend who's in your crew only gets the CREW join/leave alert, not a FRIEND one as well by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.63+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Session Stats: the Infusion and Bottle dry streaks only count catches during a Blood Moon (capsules) or a thunderstorm / supercell (bottles), like All-Time Stats; they counted every fish by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.62+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Chests get the Bait Sorter and Pet Sorter boxes too, sorting the whole chest (single or double); everything else in it stays put by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.61+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Alerts: the Garaboncias rainbow timer now ends the moment 'RAINBOW » The Rainbow has faded into the sky.' shows in chat (it waited for the boss bar's weather to change), and remembers how long the rainbow really lasted by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.60+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- New Session Stats panel: everything All-Time Stats shows (fish, fish/hour, fish time, quests, pets, shards, capsules, bottles, rarities, gigantic, variants), for this session only; cleared when you log out. On by default, can be turned off and moved like the other panels by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.59+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- New bobber timer (from FOE): how long your bobber has been out, like 12.4s, over your own bobber; it hides once a fish is on. On by default; turn it (or the 's') off in the render settings by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.58+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel: new 'Only show at the event's location' setting (off by default), so the Kenai mini event only shows while you're at Kenai River by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.57+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Events panel: new 'Show event descriptions' setting (on by default) to hide what an event does, like 'Shards 1 in 25' or '+100% Pet Luck', and keep just the name and timer by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.56+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Top bar: the spot next to the location (Port Moosehorn...) no longer blinks off and on; it stays until you've really left it by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.55+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Events panel: the ~ before the Blooming Oasis and Gold Rush timers is gone by @phckd
- Pet panel: common pets get their white-grey rarity frame too; the frame is drawn over the pet so a big pet model can't hide it, and the rarity is read from the pet's badge when its data doesn't have it by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.54+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel: GIGANTIC and variant missions only go up when you actually catch that size or variant (at that place), going by the same catch details as the FOE+ alerts. The server writes GIGANTIC in small capitals, which FOE+ didn't recognise, so every catch at Kenai counted for it by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.53+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel: after a gigantic or variant catch (the ones FOE+ alerts about), the missions are re-checked in a few seconds, so GIGANTIC and variant missions tick right away by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.52+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel: GIGANTIC, ALBINO, MELANISTIC and TROPHY missions only take the server's numbers (no more counts that jump up and back); fish-name and place missions still go up on each catch by @phckd
- Variant badges on the Mini Event panel are drawn in their own colours (they were tinted by the line's colour) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.51+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel: ALBINO, MELANISTIC and TROPHY missions no longer vanish and come back: their badge was ignored, so any Kenai fish counted for them. They now only go up for that variant (or wait for the server's numbers) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.50+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel: fish names are the server's green again (the 1.0.49 colours are undone) by @phckd
- Missions go up the moment you catch something that counts, like the Daily Quests panel; the quiet check confirms within about a minute and never skips a catch by @phckd
- A finished mission shows one ✔ for a few seconds, then leaves the panel until the daily reroll; repeatable missions (∞) stay. FOE+ checks again right after the reroll by @phckd
- GIGANTIC missions use the GIGANTIC badge by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.49+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel: fish missions show the fish's name in its rarity colour, like the Fish Compendium (FOE+ learns the colours whenever you open the compendium, and from fish in your inventory) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.48+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Personal Vault: the bait sort buttons sit in a small 'Bait Sorter' box by @phckd
- New 'Pet Sorter' box on the right of the Personal Vault: sort the page's pets by Percent (highest first), Rarity or Name; baits and other items stay put; Shift-click to reverse by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.47+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Changelog is easier to read: smaller text in a centred column, and shorter version headings by @phckd
- Events panel: the wavy icon before Fish Frenzy is gone by @phckd
- Daily Quests panel: rarity badges like MYTHICAL are drawn in their own colours again (they were tinted green) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.46+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- The divider bar above the quiet /minievent answer no longer shows up in chat by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.45+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel is tidier: just 'Rerolls 23h 55m 2s' above the missions (the event name and end time are gone) by @phckd
- Fixed the crew list: the server's /crew heads no longer carry a player id or name (only a skin), so FOE+ found no members. It now reads each member from the head's label ('GhostZland (Offline)'), with their id from the tab list (filled in when an offline member comes online). Open /crew once to reload by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.44+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Mini Event panel now shows the missions (the mark before each one is the server's status icon, which FOE+ took for a dash and stopped reading at) by @phckd
- The quiet /minievent check no longer leaves the mission list in chat: its whole answer is hidden by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.43+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- HUD editor (Move HUD) no longer lags: the red guide lines and the shaded boxes were drawn one pixel / one column at a time (thousands of draws a frame); now one draw each by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.42+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Crew list is back to how it worked before 1.0.39 (the 1.0.39 and 1.0.40 crew changes are undone); open /crew once to reload it by @phckd
- New /foe crew dump: copies what the /crew screen's heads hold to your clipboard (for fixing crew problems; changes nothing) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.41+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- New Mini Event panel: the event from /minievent with its end and daily reroll countdowns and every mission's progress, in the server's colours; hidden when no mini event is on by @phckd
- FOE+ checks /minievent quietly every 10 minutes and a few seconds after a catch (at most every 3 minutes), hiding its answer; your own /minievent still shows by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.40+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fixed crew members going missing from Timers & Crew: /crew heads that come with only a skin all had the same empty id, so they collapsed into one blank entry. Each one is now kept by name (its real id is filled in once they're online). Open /crew once to reload your crew by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.39+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Timers & Crew: fixed a crew member showing with no name (some /crew heads come without one: FOE+ now takes the name on the item, then the tab list or your friends list) by @phckd
- A friend in your crew is recognised by name too, so they keep the crew colour and star by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.38+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- The inventory search bar no longer shows the big search help box over your inventory (the Personal Vault still does) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.37+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Pets holding an amulet get their star in the amulet's rarity colour (a Fabled Amulet gives a red star) by @phckd
- Search bar above your inventory, the same as the Personal Vault's (red outline on matches; toggle in the inventory settings) by @phckd
- While typing in a search bar, Q and the number keys no longer drop or swap the item under your mouse by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.36+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Events panel shows a Gold Rush (⚠ on the boss bar, base shard chance 1 in 25) with about 15 minutes counting down, from the chat announcement, /events or the boss bar; it goes when the ⚠ does by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.35+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fixed an empty chat line that showed every 15 minutes: the blank lines around FOE+'s quiet /events (and community event) check are hidden now too by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.34+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- All-Time Stats Fish Time now comes from the server: FOE+ reads 'Time Fishing' from your profile in /menu once each login (quietly, in the background) and counts up from there while you fish; the next login checks it again by @phckd
- Reset Fish Timer now only resets fish per hour; Fish Time keeps following the server by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.33+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Timers & Crew: the star next to a friend in your crew is now the same orange as the Crew colour by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.32+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Timers & Crew: a friend who's in your crew shows in light blue with a yellow star (now spaced from the name); friends not in your crew are just blue by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.31+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Events panel: an active Fish Frenzy (where, and time left of its hour) and an active Fabled event (until it's caught) by @phckd
- FOE+ checks /events quietly every 15 minutes and hides the answer, keeping the frenzy and the Tackle Shop / Cosmetic Store timers in sync with the server by @phckd
- Cosmetic Store timer fixed: it resets at 7pm EST (midnight UTC), an hour earlier than before by @phckd
- Global Luck / Scale boosters: a live countdown next to Luck or Scale on the Luck & Scale panel by @phckd
- Removed the drop / craft line under the cryptid alerts by @phckd
- Events panel also shows a Blooming Oasis (+100% pet luck) while its ♣ is on the boss bar, with about 15 minutes counting down by @phckd
- Lightning in a Bottle dry streak only counts fish caught in a thunderstorm or supercell (not rain) by @phckd
- Max rod parts get a bright purple border round the slot instead of the gold star by @phckd
- The pet item marker only shows on pets holding an amulet, not on pets with just a skin or trail by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.30+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Removed FOE-R's Fishing Statistics list from the inventory (All-Time Stats shows the same); it can be turned back on in the inventory settings by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.29+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Timers & Crew box next to your inventory: moon, Tackle Shop, Cosmetic Store and vote timers, crew range, and your crew and friends with a + to add a friend (the list scrolls) by @phckd
- The Timers & Crew HUD panel stays too, showing the same lines by @phckd
- Gold star on rod parts rolled at their rarity's max stat, and on rods with two different max stats (inventory, hotbar and equipment bar) by @phckd
- Location names in the HUDs and chat use the server's own colours (as in /tt), gradients included by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.28+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Timers & Crew panel: Vote line showing how many of the 7 sites you've voted on in the last 24 hours, and when you can vote again by @phckd
- Tackle Shop gets a ✔ once you've opened it since it restocked by @phckd
- /foe users lists every FOE+ and FOE-R user you've been near this session who's still online (and you), not only the ones in your instance by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.27+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Witching Hour is now 1am to 3am by @phckd
- HUD panels no longer push each other around: they stay where you put them and may overlap, and a panel whose text changes width (like a countdown) no longer jumps sideways by @phckd
- New Timers & Crew panel: moon, Tackle Shop (every 4 hours) and Cosmetic Store (8pm New York) timers, then your crew and friends with who's in range and who's online by @phckd
- Friends list: /foe friend add, remove and list by @phckd
- Chat line when a crew member or friend comes online or goes offline by @phckd
- No wrong-gear warning at Cypress Lake's spawn until you reach the water by @phckd
- Top bar shows the spot you're at (Big Bear Dock, Thunderwood Marina...), and the spot name no longer flickers away by @phckd
- Pet panel: the pet's frame takes its rarity colour by @phckd
- Vault sort only moves baits and lures (pets stay put), and has a Name sort that groups every Crankbait together by @phckd
- Inspect can be Hold key, Always On, Pets Only or Armor Only by @phckd
- /foe item copies the held item's data, for bug reports by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.26+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fixed pet and shard dry streaks jumping by thousands when your fish total updated from your server stats by @phckd
- Import Dry Streaks repairs streaks that jumped, and brings over your capsule, bottle, pet and shard totals from FOE when they're higher there by @phckd
- Edit All-Time Stats in the O menu: fix any total by hand (fish caught, pets, shards, capsules, bottles, quests, rarities, variants and Gigantic) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.25+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- New All-Time Stats top: Total Caught with the share of your catches that were fish, then Total Pets, Shards, Infusion and Bottle, each with its dry streak by @phckd
- Lightning in a Bottle is now tracked, with its own chat line by @phckd
- Infusion Capsule and Lightning Bottle dry streaks count only Blood Moon and thunderstorm catches, like FOE by @phckd
- Import Dry Streaks also brings over your pet, shard, Infusion Capsule and Lightning Bottle streaks from FOE by @phckd
- Edit Dry Streaks has pets, shards, Infusion Capsules and Lightning Bottles by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.24+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- The + after FOE+ users' names is now even: both strokes are 2 pixels thick (the bold + was thicker up and down than across) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.23+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Bobber menu in O, laid out like + Colour, with 16 presets: Classic, Cherry, Ocean, Ice, Lime, Emerald, Mint, Gold, Bee, Pumpkin, Lava, Candy, Royal, Galaxy, Midnight and Snow by @phckd
- FOE+ users near you see your bobber preset, and you see theirs by @phckd
- Glass bobber removed by @phckd
- Bobber button moved under + Colour by @phckd
- A 1-pixel gap between names and the +, so they no longer touch by @phckd
- All-Time Stats shows how many Infusion Capsules you've pulled, without the capsule dry streak for now by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.22+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- 3D bobber presets: Classic, Ocean, Lime, Gold, Pumpkin, Candy, Royal, Midnight and Glass by @phckd
- Bobber button in the O menu: click for the next preset, Shift-click for the previous one by @phckd
- Your preset shows on your own bobber, so it's easy to spot; a setting puts it on everyone's by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.21+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Bait sorter (B) can sort by amount, most or fewest first by @phckd
- B remembers the order you last picked on the vault's Amount / Rarity buttons, so it no longer re-sorts the vault by rarity by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.20+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Auto Tip chat lines show the chummer's rarity badge instead of the word by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.19+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fix Luck & Scale and Daily Quests not updating when you change location while fishing by @phckd
- The Quests panel reads /quests in the background when you arrive somewhere new by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.18+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fix the solid black box behind floating server text (like FISH MERCHANT) with Photon and other shaders by @phckd
- New setting Floating text backgrounds: AUTO (hidden only with shaders on), HIDE or SHOW by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.17+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- + Colour opens a colour menu with swatches and a preview, instead of clicking through by @phckd
- The developer and beta testers can pick a colour too, or keep their own by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.16+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Pick your + colour in the O menu (16 colours); everyone with FOE+ sees it by @phckd
- Shorter community event on the top bar: COM 88.9K/100K (352) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.15+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Community event on the top bar: the community total and your contribution by @phckd
- Your contribution goes up with every catch, and FOE+ checks /communityevent quietly every 10 minutes (never while a menu is open) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.14+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Quests panel lines up in columns whatever the progress by @phckd
- Long location names on the Quests panel are shortened (Toledo Bend Reservoir shows as Toledo) by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.13+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fix freezing when hovering armor: the Identifier player name is looked up in the background, not on the game thread by @phckd
- Player names that can't be found are retried after 10 minutes instead of every few ticks by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.12+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- The FOE+ logo on name tags is the same size as FOE-R's and no longer overlaps the level by @phckd
- FOE-R users keep the FOE-R logo, FOE+ users get the FOE+ logo by @phckd
- New /foe users command: lists who FOE+ has seen running FOE-R or FOE+ by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.11+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- FOE+ users show the FOE+ logo before their name; FOE-R users keep the FOE-R logo by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.10+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- New FOE+ logo for the mod icon by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.9+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Special thanks to DannyPX and Kimberly in the changelog by @phckd
- Rainbow + on the developer's name tag by @phckd
- Green + on beta testers' name tags by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.8+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- Remove the estimated price from pet tooltips by @phckd

entries.name: FOE+ 1.0.0+1.21.11
entries.changelog:
## What's Changed
- First FOE+ release, renamed from FOE-R (settings, stats and dry streaks carry over) by @phckd
- Fix menus freezing, where you could move but clicks, casting and NPCs stopped working by @phckd
- Fix FPS drops in menus and with many HUD panels by @phckd
- Bessie shows once during a moon, with the moon odds by @phckd
- Remove the Last Fabled record until it's reworked by @phckd
- Infusion Capsule chat alert, dry streak and All-Time Stats row by @phckd
- Witching Hour no longer pops up at noon by @phckd
- HUD panels keep their spot and only move up or down to avoid another panel by @phckd
- Alerts panel: Witching Hour, Titanoboa, Bessie, Rougarou, Garaboncias and Fabled events with timers by @phckd
- Moon timer synced to the server's moon cycle by @phckd
- Luck & Scale panel read from your /menu profile, boosters included by @phckd
- Daily Quests panel updates on every catch by @phckd
- Contest panel always shows the top 3, the fish you need, and updates on a new personal best by @phckd
- Exact pet per location, with a wrong-pet warning you can hide with - by @phckd
- Pet panel shows your pet's held item by @phckd
- Chat lines for pet pulls, variants and Gigantic catches with dry streaks by @phckd
- Import dry streaks and stats from old FOE and FOE-R installs, newer streaks are never overwritten by @phckd
- Edit Dry Streaks screen in the O menu by @phckd
- Personal Vault sorting by amount or rarity, and rank badges on locked pages by @phckd
- Auto Tip with badges, Inspect always-on toggle, and a + after other FOE+ users' names by @phckd
- New O menu with the FOE+ logo by @phckd

FOE+ is built on FishonMC-Extras-R, with features from FOECollab and FishOnAutotip.

## Special Thanks
A huge shoutout to **DannyPX** for creating FOE-R (FishonMC-Extras-R), and to **Kimberly** for creating FOE (FOECollab and FishOnAutotip). FOE+ wouldn't exist without them.
